## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result, why it is needed, and the affected OKFleet surfaces.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran. Include TUI captures for material visual changes.

## Release and compatibility

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feat:`, and so on).
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or this change does not require a test.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated, or behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] Fleet chat remains read-only and source-bundle writes remain staged by default.
- [ ] Unknown OKF types and frontmatter fields remain supported.
- [ ] Generated skill helpers and plugin manifests are synchronized where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private bundle content, sensitive paths, or authenticated provider
      transcripts are included.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out migration concerns, follow-up work, or areas where you want specific feedback.
